_style_version_note: v5 stopped generating the slab. assets/base-tile.png is passed as referenceImages[0] on
every tile and the model only adds the object on top, so the base cannot drift in colour,
shape or camera. Subjects therefore describe the OBJECT ONLY — any mention of paving,
grass or a plot re-specifies the slab and invites the model to replace it.
Never mix versions on one board; re-run every tile after a bump.

spec._tile_base_color_note: Measured from assets/base-tile.png, which supplies the slab. Not a target for the generator to hit — it is what the reference already contains.
spec._max_height_note: Low by design. The camera-derived ceiling is higher, but tall pieces hide the token and the tiles behind them, so the style targets a fifth of a tile width for the object; 0.3 is the check threshold, since the base slab counts toward measured height.
